version.changelog: This release updates the server only. If REAPER is running the 1.10.0 bridge, you don't have to do anything in REAPER. If you're updating from 1.9.5 or earlier, update the bridge as the 1.10.0 notes below describe. Fixed: - render_region always returned an error. It now renders the master mix over the region numbered region_index in get_regions, from its start to its end. It takes render_project's other options and gives the same response, plus region with the region's number, name, start and end.
